reviews.title: Good AIO

reviews.title: Great water cooler for the price
reviews.comment: Kept temperatures way down. This was super easy to install. The software is a bit clunky, but it has a display screen built in thst you can customize, and can display temperature right on it. Pretty average size for a cooler, more than enough for my gaming needs. Overall, super happy with this. And really digging how display screen looks. Way cheaper than other water cooling units and performs just as well.
